snippet.title: SpongeBob SquarePants Lights, Camera, Pants! - Longplay | 100% (Hard Difficulty) [4K]
snippet.description:
In this Longplay of the console version of SpongeBob SquarePants Lights, Camera, Pants! I play through the whole of the Bronze, Silver and Gold Story Challenge on Hard / Smart Difficulty finishing it 100%. This means I unlock all Artworks and Action Figures. I try to set good high scores in each Audition (Minigame) which results in me achieving 5000 Popularity Points for all of them except "Floor It" (Silver, Gold), Beats Me" (Bronze, Silver, Gold), "Machine Meltdown" (Silver) and "Rope Burn" (Silver, Gold) which are impossible. After finishing Story Mode the game plays the Mermaid Man Movie in full length in this case with SpongeBob on Bronze, Patrick on Silver and Squidward on Gold. Each character playing every roll including the Sneaky Hermit in their respective Story Mode Movie. After each Story Mode I play the unlocked Minigame(s) and unlock the respective Action Figure and/or Artwork. After finishing Gold Story Mode I play every other Audition and show all Artworks, Action Figures, Codes and everything else.
In general you could say I try to playthrough the game as smoothly and quickly as possible and showing everything there is to give the best viewing experience.
